title: 7d98(i): TunnelAuthResource mounted at /.well-known/tunnel-auth via build_site
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-7d98. New python/src/lichen/coap/resources/tunnel_auth.py: CoAP resource wrapping lichen.gateway.tunnel_auth.TunnelAuthorizationTable (receive_post) — POST COSE_Sign1 -> 2.04 Changed on permit, 4.03 Forbidden with denial reason on deny (per parent b7z9.35 wiring note: C uses 204/403 literals; confirm CoAP 2.04/4.03 mapping here). Mount in build_site via optional tunnel_authorizations param (None = not mounted, per optional-resource pattern). Tests: POST valid authorization (from test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json fixtures) -> 2.04, POST tampered/wrong-egress/expired -> 4.03 with diagnostic, GET/other methods -> 4.05, absent param -> not in site.
close_reason: Implemented the /.well-known/tunnel-auth CoAP resource and mounted it: new python/src/lichen/coap/resources/tunnel_auth.py — TunnelAuthResource POST wraps lichen.gateway.tunnel_auth.TunnelAuthorizationTable.receive_post (the fail-closed table: OSCORE-required, root binding, COSE signature, egress binding, horizon, replay — all unchanged). Authentication reuses the established post-unprotect OSCORE rule from the messaging resource (_request_is_oscore_protected) plus a transport-bound remote hostinfo; sender IID = remote address packed[8:] (IPv4/hostname remotes fail closed to empty IID which the table rejects). Uniform 4.03 on every denial with result.denial only in logs (wire non-disclosure preserved; empty payload also 4.03 fail-closed). build_site gained optional tunnel_authorizations (None = not mounted, per optional-resource pattern) mounted at the FULL TUNNEL_AUTH_PATH (derived from TUNNEL_AUTH_RESOURCE — single source of truth). Reviewer caught a real mount bug in my first patch ([:-1] truncated the path to /.well-known where aiocoap would 4.04 on dispatch) — fixed and the test now exercises the real build_site path via site._resources (full-path key assert with explanatory comment). Tests: 8 (valid 2.04 + table size 1; wrong-egress 4.03 state unchanged; non-OSCORE denied; empty payload denied; replay 2.04-then-4.03 with table growth once; GET/PUT/DELETE 4.05; build_site mount reaches the full path with the SAME table instance). tunnel_auth suites 28 passed (7 new + 21 pre-existing), coap+gateway full suites 2056 passed (2 EDHOC flakes = the documented pre-existing flakiness; pass in isolation and are unrelated to this module); ruff clean. Sibling 7d98.2 (data-plane egress wiring) stays open: it needs a Python gateway forwarding path to wire INTO, which does not exist in this checkout (gateway binaries are C/Zephyr + Rust — parent b7z9.35 confirms both are also unwired).
